stages.name: Preschool
stages.summary: Preschool is Junior (Beginner, Pre 1, Pre 1 A) and Senior (Pre 2, Pre KG). English, Myanmar, and Chinese are taught as the early-years foundation.
hours: Regular and part-time tracks list the same five stages: Beginner and Pre 1 (4 months each), Pre 1 A (4 months), Pre 2 and Pre-KG (6 months each).
notes: Computing starts from the first stage; field trips are part of the preschool programme.
The page says children can continue at ILBC or at state schools after preschool.

stages.name: Primary
stages.summary: After Kindergarten, Primary 1–6 continues Myanmarsar, English, Mathematics, Geography, History, Science, Health & Fitness, Music, Fine Arts, Information Technology, and Coding. Thai is optional.
hours: KG to Primary 3 regular: 8:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m., Monday to Friday.
Primary 4 to Secondary 6 regular: 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m., Monday to Friday.
Part-time: 8:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m., Saturday and Sunday. Academic year June to March.
notes: TIL classrooms are used for geography, science, and computing, with field trips and lab or computer access.
To enter Secondary 1, Primary 6 students need an average of 50 marks and a clear pass in English.

stages.name: Secondary · IGCSE and IAL
stages.summary: Six secondary years. Secondary 4 prepares for the IGCSE examinations in May. Secondary 5–6 prepare for university entry. About ILBC names the framework as Edexcel Pearson IGCSE and IAL.
hours: Primary 4 to Secondary 6 regular: 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m., Monday to Friday.
Part-time: 8:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m., Saturday and Sunday. Academic year June to March.

years.name: Secondary 3
years.note: The official page calls Secondary 3 a challenging year, with science subjects split into Physics, Biology, and Chemistry.

years.name: Secondary 4
years.note: Secondary 4 prepares students for the IGCSE examinations held in May.

years.name: Secondary 5
subjects: World History and Social Science Myanmar
World Geography and Social Science Myanmar

years.name: Secondary 6
subjects: World History and Social Science Myanmar
World Geography and Social Science Myanmar
years.note: Secondary 5 and 6 are described as university-entry programmes after IGCSE.

b0595924-73f7-49c4-94b0-b05017d77ef8.framework: U.S. curriculum through Grade 10 · IB Diploma Grades 11–12

stages.name: Early Years · Chinthe Cubs and Kindergarten
stages.summary: Elementary includes Chinthe Cubs (ages 3 and 4) and Kindergarten. Early learning is described as a Reggio-inspired environment with play, projects, music, and physical education. Apply says Chinthe Cubs 3, 4, and Kindergarten applicants must be three, four, and five by 31 August.
notes: Home and About also call Early Years Chinthe Cubs (ages 3–4) plus Kindergarten.
Apply: Chinthe Cubs and Kindergarten applicants must be toilet trained.

stages.name: Elementary · Grades 1 to 5
stages.summary: U.S. standards-based programme. Common Core for mathematics and English language arts, Next Generation Science Standards, and AERO social studies. Specialists include PE, music, visual arts, library, Myanmar language/history/culture, and world languages.
subjects: Myanmar Culture, Language, History and Geography
World Languages (French or Mandarin from Grade 2)
notes: Myanmar students and international students have separate Myanmar culture/language/history/geography tracks.
World languages begin in Grade 2 for students without native fluency in French or Mandarin.
Swimming is taught year-round in Elementary PE.

stages.name: Middle School · Grades 6 to 8
stages.summary: All Middle School students take a fixed core plus a weekly advisory. Standards are organised as Grade 6 to 10 continuums.
subjects: Myanmar Culture, Language, History, and Geography

stages.name: High School · Grades 9 and 10 (pre-IB)
stages.summary: Grades 9 and 10 are described as the pre-IB years. Students take a U.S. core and must complete one Art and one Technology elective by the end of Grade 10. Electives vary by year.

years.name: Grade 9–10 electives named on the page
years.note: Offerings vary by student interest and staffing. Students pick in preference order.

stages.name: IB Diploma · Grades 11 and 12
stages.summary: ISY is an IB World School. All Grade 11 and 12 students take the Diploma Programme. A January 2024 IB visit reauthorised the programme for another five years. Students take one course from each of six groups plus TOK, the Extended Essay, and CAS.
notes: FAQ also says Grades 11–12 may take Spanish ab initio or a mother-tongue course.
High School Profile is linked for IB results and university acceptances; amounts and percentages on that PDF were not extracted in this pass.

stages.name: Primary
stages.summary: Our Early Years Department at MISY consists of one Nursery class for students aged 3-4 and one Reception class for students aged 4-5. Classes are facilitated by experienced Early Years practitioners who are supported by well-qualified teaching assistants.

stages.name: Secondary
stages.summary: Head of Secondary I am very proud to be leading a well qualified and trained team of teachers who are able to implement our vision of high quality teaching and learning to lead our students to achieve holistic growth and success.

stages.name: English As An Additional Language
stages.summary: EAL stands for English as an Additional Language and is offered for students who require extra support or particular learning strategies to aid their English language acquisition.

stages.name: Preschool / Early Years
stages.summary: Our international preschool programme is packed with awe-inspiring experiences that nurture a lifelong love of learning.…

stages.name: Primary
stages.summary: Our carefully considered combination of the English National Curriculum and the International Primary Curriculum (IPC) provides a strong foundation for future learning.

stages.name: Secondary
stages.summary: At The British School Yangon, we deliver an outstanding secondary education that will prepare your child for IGCSE and A-level success.…

stages.name: Upper secondary
stages.summary: The highest levels of personalised, continuous, and focused support will ensure your child succeeds academically and personally at The British School Yangon.

stages.name: Preschool
stages.summary: UK EYFS. The page says eight developmental areas and then lists seven. Daily English, Mandarin, and Myanmar. Forest School outdoor learning.
notes: Groups: Pre-Nursery ages 2–3, Nursery 3–4, Reception 4–5.
Golden Valley preschool page also names Pre-Nursery to Reception and nature play.

stages.name: Primary
stages.summary: The group Primary page says students sit Pearson Edexcel iPrimary at the end of Year 6, in a trilingual English / Myanmar / Chinese setting. Star City and Thuwunna pages instead emphasise Cambridge Checkpoint in Year 6.
notes: HSK Chinese exams are optional.
Thuwunna Primary calls the school Cambridge accredited and cites 2024–25 CIE Primary Checkpoint results.

stages.name: Lower Secondary
stages.summary: The group page says students sit Pearson Edexcel iSecondary at the end of Year 9. Star City names Cambridge Checkpoint in Year 9. Thuwunna Secondary says Years 7–9 prepare for Cambridge IGCSE.
notes: Pun Hlaing says Cambridge British international curriculum from Early Years to Lower Secondary. Taunggyi offers Nursery to Year 8.

stages.name: Upper Secondary · IGCSE
stages.summary: The group IGCSE page offers both Edexcel and Cambridge. Thuwunna Secondary describes a two-year Cambridge IGCSE programme and publishes May/June 2025 results of 78% A*–A.

years.name: IGCSE subjects named on the group page
Thuwunna Secondary IGCSE suite
years.note: Named on the Thuwunna Secondary page.

notes: Thuwunna Secondary says scholarships cover 10% of students from Years 9 to 11, on academic merit and need.

stages.name: Pre-university · KIC Bahan
stages.summary: KINGS International College Bahan offers NCUK International Foundation Year and Pearson Edexcel A Levels. The home page also names overseas-education advisory services.

years.name: NCUK IFY
years.note: 9 months from September or 7 months from January. Entry: high school or equivalent, IELTS 5.0 or equivalent, reference and interview.

years.name: Pearson Edexcel A Levels
years.note: Two years, typically 3–4 subjects. Entry: strong secondary record, IELTS 5.5 or equivalent, interview and assessment. The page does not list the subject menu.
subjects: A Level subjects (menu not published on this page)

stages.name: Early Years Foundation Stage
stages.summary: PISM follows the statutory EYFS framework. Seven areas of learning: three prime and four specific. Nursery uses Letters and Sounds Phase 1; Kindergarten moves to Phase 2 and 3 phonics.
hours: EYFS day: 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., with nap time 1:10 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. (FAQ).
notes: FAQ lists Pre-Nursery, Nursery, and Kindergarten for ages 2.5 to 5.
The page lists Early Learning Goals under each area; those are outcomes, not extra subjects.

stages.name: Primary · Key Stage 1 and 2
stages.summary: Cambridge Primary for English, Mathematics, and Science. Other subjects follow the English National Curriculum. Myanmar Language is twice a week.
hours: Year 2 to Year 6: 8:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.
notes: Key Stage 2 PE names football, handball, softball, basketball, badminton, table tennis, and karate.
Computing pages mention dedicated computer rooms and e-safety.

stages.name: Secondary · Key Stage 3
stages.summary: Ten compulsory subjects: English, Mathematics, and Science as core; ICT, History, Geography, and Myanmar Studies as main; Art and Design, PE, and Music as enhancement. English follows Cambridge English as a Second Language for lower secondary.
hours: Year 7 to Year 10: 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.

stages.name: IGCSE · Key Stage 4
stages.summary: The Key Stage 4 page lists Cambridge IGCSE subjects and says some are offered now and some in the near future. About and Secondary overview name a shorter current set.

years.name: Key Stage 4
years.note: Curriculum page list. About currently names ESL, Maths, Additional Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Business Studies, History, and ICT.

notes: FAQ: Year 11 students can sit IGCSE at PISM as a CAIE exam centre.
Secondary overview also names Economics and says History, Geography, Human Biology, and World Literature are planned as later options.

stages.name: AS / A Level · Key Stage 5
stages.summary: After IGCSE the Secondary overview says PISM offers GCE A Levels in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry, plus IELTS for English-language university entry.
notes: FAQ lists AS/A Level as Key Stage 5, Years 12 and 13. The curriculum page does not publish a full A Level subject table.

stages.summary: A May 2026 pamphlet for Helix International Pre-School at No.15(A) Padonmar Street. The Programs page also lists early subjects such as Jolly Phonics, though the Programs intro says academic programmes start at Primary 4.

stages.name: Primary 1 to 6
stages.summary: Primary pamphlet for No.15(D) Padonmar Street. Campus-only subjects: Myanmar Studies, Art and Music, Extra Activity. Online students can transfer to campus by paying the documentation and facility difference.

stages.name: Secondary
stages.summary: Year 7 is listed at Padonmar 15(D). Years 8–9 / Pre-IGCSE are listed at No.301 Shwedagon Pagoda Road.

years.name: Year 7
years.note: 10 months. Myanmar Studies, Art and Music, and Extra Activity are campus only.

stages.name: IGCSE
stages.summary: Edexcel International GCSE at Manawhari Campus. About names Helix as Edexcel Approved Centre No. 94981, partnered with British Council Yangon. Pearson World First and Country First awards are claimed on the Programs page.
notes: Programs page groups IGCSE into Social Science; Engineering and Technology; Business, Maths and Computer Science; and Health and Science streams.

stages.name: A Level
stages.summary: A Level pamphlet at Manawhari Campus. Subjects listed: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and IT.

stages.name: OSSD
stages.summary: Programs links an OSSD pamphlet (May 2026). A news post says community activity is required for the Ontario Secondary School Diploma. The pamphlet text was not extracted in this pass, so no subject list is shown.
notes: Pamphlet: https://www.helixuniversitycollege.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/OSSD_Pamphlet.pdf

stages.name: Preschool / Early Years
stages.summary: Preschool is open to children from 2 to 5 year-old (see age guidelines).…

stages.name: Primary
stages.summary: Primary school includes 5 grades (usually from age 6 to 11, see age guidelines), corresponding to Grades 1-5 in the US education system and Year 2-6 in the UK (see equivalents here).

stages.name: Secondary
stages.summary: Secondary school comprises Middle School (“collège”) and High School (“lycée”), usually from age 11 to 18. The LFIR is reopening the middle school in 2023, starting with the first year (children aged 11 or French 6ème / US grade 6 / UK year 7).
